LanguageData.ER_QuestDescription:
A fragment of an old transmission mentions a cache of resurrector mech serum. Most of the coordinates are missing, but an ancient complex nearby may hold records of the shipment.

Other archives are mentioned in the transmission. Following the trail could take you far from home, and there is no telling what still guards these places.

If you hope to bring {0} back, preserve their remains.
LanguageData.ER_StageDescription: The trail leads to another ancient complex. Its terminals may contain the missing shipment records. You will need to piece together the data from all of them before moving on.\n\nThe location will remain accessible for 30 days. Anything left unread may be lost when you leave.
LanguageData.ER_FinalDescription: The records point to a secure archive linked to the serum shipment. Its terminals hold the last access codes, but the installation's defenders are still there. Some may only be dormant.\n\nRecover the codes and secure the site to release the shipment. You have 30 days before the connection is lost.
LanguageData.ER_TerminalDiscovered: A terminal containing mechanite archive information has been discovered.
LanguageData.ER_SettingsDelay: Quest arrival after an eligible colonist dies
LanguageData.ER_SettingsMinimumMembership: Minimum time as a colonist: {0} days
LanguageData.ER_SettingsMembershipExplanation: 0–60 days of actual colonist membership. Set to 0 to allow newly joined colonists. Prisoners, slaves, guests and other ineligible pawns remain excluded.
LanguageData.ER_SettingsTimingExplanation: Applies to future deaths. A scheduled opportunity keeps its original arrival time. Immediately means the next game tick; the game must be unpaused. The 60-day global cooldown and one-chain limit still apply.
